title: git-complement-audit: auditing every path Git keeps outside HEAD
description: Zero-dependency CLI that measures what a Git repository keeps outside HEAD -- unmerged commits behind hidden refs, detached worktrees nobody adopted, paths a reset dropped, blobs no ref can name -- classifies every path in that complement, and says whether anything in it is worth saving before 'git worktree prune' or 'git gc --prune' destroys it. The audit reads: it writes no file and mutates no ref, and the only writes are the opt-in --receipt and --rescue-dir a caller asks for. Exit codes are a contract (0 clean, 1 orphaned code or secret risk, 2 invalid repository or arguments), and every pass that is skipped is declared in the report, so a clean verdict never covers bytes the instrument did not look at.
